$comment: Every public name a release renamed, reshaped or removed, with the Upgrade page section that explains it. `npx nuxt-backend upgrade` rewrites none of an app's code: the edit is yours. Generated by `pnpm generate` (scripts/agent-guidance.mjs). Do not edit: change the code it reads.

renames.section: A production checkout waits for billing to launch, and welcome credits come from the catalog
renames.note: only a sale on a production deployment with no token or no production catalog; every other refusal keeps `not_configured`

renames.section: A production checkout waits for billing to launch, and welcome credits come from the catalog
renames.note: a production deployment with a token whose catalog `billing sync --env production` never wrote; a sandbox one keeps `no_catalog`

renames.section: A production checkout waits for billing to launch, and welcome credits come from the catalog
renames.note: welcome credits on the free plan, granted once after the reverse trial; drop the hand-rolled grant

renames.section: A job joins on a balance never read
renames.note: a balance never read no longer refuses `not_synced`: the job joins, and its first step reads the balance or fails `insufficient_credits`; a balance read with no credit meter is still refused `not_ready`

renames.section: Browser error reports go through a tunnel on the app's own origin
renames.note: the peer range; an older SDK still reports, straight to the ingest, and the build and `doctor` warn

renames.section: The packaged UI reads its faces, lines and shadows from tokens
renames.note: the outermost element of every packaged component and page; `<AppShell>` marks its own controls, not its root
